updates.title: GitHub makes assisted permissions generally available across Copilot
updates.whatChanged: GitHub made assisted permissions generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code. A model evaluates command, file-path and URL requests. It lets requests it judges clearly safe proceed, while users must approve others. Enterprise admins can set defaults, block Allow All or disable assisted mode.
updates.whyCare: You can reduce routine approval prompts while keeping human review for requests the model does not classify as clearly safe. Admins can keep assisted mode available while blocking Allow All.
updates.before: Assisted permissions were not generally available. Developers could use manual approval or Allow All.
updates.after: Copilot now evaluates requested commands, file access and URL opens. It runs requests it judges clearly safe and asks for approval on others.
updates.learn: Pilot assisted mode on representative developer tasks. Review which requests proceed without approval. Set an enterprise default and decide whether policy allows Allow All.

sources.name: GitHub Changelog - Copilot assisted permissions generally available

updates.architectureImplication: Pilot assisted permissions on representative developer tasks and validate which operations proceed without review. Keep policy controls and sandboxing alongside the model's decision.
